title: audio signal
description: System-audio spectrum measured by the host app (AudioProvider.swift, Core Audio process tap; needs the 'System Audio Recording Only' permission). Streamed as Server-Sent Events at about 20 frames per second (GET /api/stream/audio); GET /api/signals/audio is a one-off snapshot (null when there is no frame file). Values are raw energies, NOT normalised: the SDK applies auto-gain. Only levels, never audio, leave the app. Not sensitive.

bands.description: 16 log-spaced band energies, 40 Hz to 12 kHz, low to high (raw).

ts.description: Frame time. Unix time in seconds (float).
